sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Speedy Trial Act sets strict deadlines for federal criminal trials. Section 3161(h)(1) excludes delay from other proceedings. Section 3161(h)(7) allows case-by-case exclusions. The parties disagree on which section applies to motion preparation time.
